text:
zoe (Sales): pinging thread — ACME asking for final checklist for SSO + SCIM POC, they want to know blockers for go/no-go this quarter
Devin (SE): quick summary from our side: SAML SSO (IdP-initiated + SP-initiated) ✅, SCIM 2.0 provisioning ✅, RBAC sync via SCIM groups (we map groups->roles) — main items are attribute mapping and domain allowlist
Simon (AE): pricing question from procurement: if they go dedicated capacity later, what’s the uplift vs hosted? I told them we can share numbers but they want a ballpark before security review
Lisa (Security): security checklist notes — need SAML metadata, IdP cert (x509), assertion attributes (email, uid, groups), SP entityID + ACS URL, and proof of IDP-initiated logout behavior. Also they requested SAML encryption option and signed assertions
Raj (ACME IdP): we can provide metadata and x509. We prefer encrypted assertions and want JIT user creation disabled — provisioning via SCIM only. Is that supported?
Devin (SE): yes we support SCIM provisioning-only mode and can disable JIT. For encrypted assertions we require our SP metadata; we can generate an encryption cert for you if needed.
Ben (Support): small gotcha: SCIM delta vs full sync — our default is delta provisioning with incremental changes, but some IdPs only support bulk/full sync. We need to know which ACME IdP supports.
Raj (ACME IdP): we support bulk sync and SCIM delta via PATCH. We tested partial attribute PATCH in our test env.
Devin (SE): perfect. Two engineering blockers to flag: 1) SCIM group size — we have a per-request limit on group membership payloads (~10k users), 2) RBAC role mapping requires group name normalization rules (we can provide a mapping config file).
zoe (Sales): can we get that mapping config template to send to their engineers? Also they asked about domain controls: they want only users with @acme.com to sign up, and ability to block wildcard subdomains
Devin (SE): attached template below — simple JSON mapping that maps SCIM groups to Redwood roles. Example:
```json
{
  "scim_group": "ACME_Engineering",
  "redwood_role": "app_developer",
  "member_claim": "groups",
  "membership_strategy": "explicit"
}
```
Devin (SE): For domain controls we support allowlist by exact domains and explicit subdomain denylist. We don't currently support regex-based domain rules in the hosted offering (can add on Dedicated/Private).
Lisa (Security): also confirm SCIM connector uses TLS 1.2+, cert pinning if they require, and logs/audit for provisioning. ACME also asked for SCIM event webhook for provisioning failures — is that available?
Ben (Support): we emit SCIM provisioning logs to the console and via the Console's audit stream. We can push provisioning failure events to a webhook (customer-managed) as an opt-in.
Raj (ACME IdP): ok good. One more: they have strict requirement — SCIM deletions must be soft-delete for 30 days (disabled accounts) before purge.
Devin (SE): we support a configurable retention window; default soft-delete 90 days but we can set 30d for POC. Need sign-off in writing for retention changes.
Simon (AE): on pricing — Zoe, recommend we give them a POC rate card: free POC for 30 days with up to 5k MAUs, then if they opt for Dedicated capacity we provide an uplift estimate: ~2.2x hosted token price plus flat infra fee. I'll draft exact numbers after security sign-off.
zoe (Sales): noted. Simon — please draft and I'll attach to RFP.
Lisa (Security): action items: Raj to provide SAML metadata + x509, ACME to confirm SCIM sync mode (bulk vs delta), and list of groups to map. We (Lisa) will run threat checklist after metadata arrives.
Raj (ACME IdP): will send metadata and a sample SCIM dump by EOD.
Devin (SE): I'll prepare the mapping template and the small runbook for running the POC (endpoints, headers, retry semantics).
zoe (Sales): great — can we tentatively schedule a 30 min tech sync tomorrow 10am PT? I'll invite Dev + Lisa + Raj
Simon (AE): +1 — add procurement call after security greenlight to go over Dedicated pricing
DeployBot: deployment notice — POC sandbox image updated (redwood/sandbox:2026-03-21), SCIM endpoint reachable at https://sandbox.api.redwood.ai/scim/v2
zoe (Sales): thanks team — I'll update the customer and post the next steps once metadata lands. :thumbsup:
